visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a massive, meticulously detailed miniature hangar. Large, cream-colored mechanical doors slide apart vertically. Tiny human figurines in orange suits populate the gridded floor in the foreground. A purple EVA Unit 01 stands within the dark opening, while a yellow EVA Unit 00 is positioned on a launch pad. (2) The camera tilts upward, tracking the ascent of EVA Unit 00 as it is raised on a vertical lift. Thick red and grey cables line the walls of the launch shaft. The lighting is focused and directional, creating deep shadows within the industrial structure of the miniature facility. (3) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of EVA Unit 01. The figure's purple and green armor is highly reflective. In the background, real-life spectators in blue and grey clothing are blurred, holding up smartphones to capture the display, indicating a gallery or exhibition setting. (4) A sequence of detail shots showcases the engineering of the models. The camera focuses on the "EVA-00" signage on a wall, then shifts to the articulated joints of a red EVA Unit 02 and the glowing green eyes of Unit 01. The textures look metallic and high-quality, with tiny printed labels visible on the armor pieces. (5) The setting changes to a vast miniature landscape of Tokyo-III city. The camera pans across a river with a small bridge, rows of residential houses, and commercial buildings with illuminated windows. Real people walk along the periphery of the model, providing a sense of the massive scale of this miniature world. (6) A close-up reveals the interior of a cockpit with miniature pilot figures. This is followed by a shot of a miniature apartment building. A tiny figure is visible through a lit window. Large blue Japanese text overlays the center of the frame before a final brand logo with glitch effects appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Dramatic orchestral strings start with a rhythmic, high-tension staccato. A female Japanese voice with a professional, broadcast-quality delivery announces launch procedures. The sound of heavy metal doors sliding is simulated with a low-frequency grinding sound and a metallic "thud" at the end of the movement. (2) A loud hydraulic hiss and a mechanical "whirr" trigger a new phase as the elevator starts. The BGM swells with triumphant brass instruments. The announcer’s voice increases in pitch variability, sounding more urgent. Ambient crowd murmur provides a low-level noise floor behind the primary signal. (3) A sharp electronic "beep" and a subsequent "clink" sound effect mark a transition. The orchestral music maintains a heroic tone at roughly 124 BPM. The vocal delivery of the announcer remains rapid and enunciated. Short, airy "whoosh" effects are timed with visual camera pans. (4) A high-pitched "Oh!" vocalization from a different female voice occurs, followed by a playful, short musical stinger. The phase concludes with a digital glitch effect and a burst of frequency noise that accompanies the visual branding, ending with a clean stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Hangar Detail -> City Panorama -> Brand Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the extreme scale and detail of a professional Evangelion miniature exhibition, highlighting both the mechanical models and the immersive miniature city environment to attract hobbyists and fans.
